self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Normal Attack DMG +40/60/80% (R1/R3/R5), Charged Attack DMG -10% at every refinement. Unconditional, so it is auto-applied (no admin toggle) at the leaderboard's chosen refinement for this weapon. Lived in self_modifiers_json at its R5 value until 2026-09-26, when gacha 4* weapons got R1/R3/R5 tiers.

en.flavor: A completely rusted iron greatbow. The average person would lack the strength to even lift it, let alone fire it.

refinements.1: Increases Normal Attack DMG by <r>40%</r> but decreases Charged Attack DMG by 10%.
refinements.2: Increases Normal Attack DMG by <r>50%</r> but decreases Charged Attack DMG by 10%.
refinements.3: Increases Normal Attack DMG by <r>60%</r> but decreases Charged Attack DMG by 10%.
refinements.4: Increases Normal Attack DMG by <r>70%</r> but decreases Charged Attack DMG by 10%.
refinements.5: Increases Normal Attack DMG by <r>80%</r> but decreases Charged Attack DMG by 10%.

fr.flavor: Un grand arc en fer complètement recouvert de rouille. Le soulever ou le manier est impossible sans posséder une force hors du commun.
